segments.he: וְלֹא לִרְבּוֹץ. אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא פַּכִּין גְּדוֹלִים, אֲבָל פַּכִּין קְטַנִּים – אוֹרְחֵיהּ הוּא.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: An animal is not considered forewarned with regard to Goring, i.e., not for goring with its horns, nor for pushing with its body, nor for biting, «nor for crouching» upon items in order to damage them. «Rabbi Elazar says: They taught» this «only» with regard to «large vessels,» as it is atypical for an animal to crouch upon them, and therefore the act is classified as a subcategory of Goring. «But» if the animal crouched upon «small vessels,» since that «is its» typical «manner» of behavior, it is classified as a subcategory of Trampling, for which the animal is considered forewarned from the outset.

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי אלעזר: לא שנו אלא פכין גדולים

edges.about: crouching is atypical only on large vessels; on small vessels it is typical

positions.claim: crouching on small vessels is typical (forewarned); only large vessels are atypical
